## Report Type

_Select one:_

- [ ] Policy / Code of Conduct concern
- [ ] Safety / privacy concern
- [ ] Documentation correction
- [ ] Resource/tool update
- [ ] Community process improvement

## Summary

Provide a concise technical summary of the issue.

## Context

- Affected document/channel:
- Date/time observed:
- Impacted members (if applicable):

## Evidence

List verifiable references (links, screenshots, message excerpts). Redact personal data where possible.

## Risk Assessment

- Potential harm if unresolved:
- Legal/ethical concern involved:
- Urgency level: Low / Medium / High

## Proposed Resolution

Describe the correction, moderation action, or process improvement you recommend.

## Additional Notes

Include anything else moderators/maintainers should know.
